description.value: SUD Café is a French-inspired café in Vancouver's West End, founded by the owners of Gastown's PETRICHOR restaurant and devoted to the relaxed culinary spirit of the South of France. The kitchen turns out house-made pastries and viennoiserie—croissants, fougasse, moelleux au chocolat—alongside brunch sandwiches built on fresh brioche and a full espresso bar with specialty drinks like apricot-lavender iced matcha. Its intimate space doubles as a private-events venue, making it a versatile neighbourhood anchor for cyclists exploring the West End.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for sudcafe.net is fully accessible and serves as strong primary evidence. The address (1082 Cardero Street, V6G 1S6, Vancouver, BC) and email (info@sudcafe.net) both match OSM exactly, confirming the listing. The menu clearly features multiple vegetarian items; a /cart subpage exists alongside the Gift Card page suggesting food-order takeout capability, but no evidence of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM tags or anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active café with a live website, detailed menu, and confirmed address. A practical food-and-coffee stop for touring cyclists in the West End.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian options: Roasted Vegetable Sando, Avocado Toast, Spinach & Mushroom Feuilleté, Ratatouille & Goat Cheese Feuilleté, Blueberry Granola Parfait, and Small Spring Mix. No explicit vegan or gluten-free labelling found
